purpose: two-domain, fresh-initialization intensity adaptation control; not author-exact case preprocessing
initialization: random initialization, method configuration from previous protocol, no pretrained segmentation checkpoint
training: site1 then site2, 20 epochs per task, batch8; S3R shape prior 50 epochs per task and normal importance estimation; original label conversion unchanged
evaluation: site1 and site2 validation only after second task, each arm uses its own training intensity mapping, foreground micro Dice and prediction/reference rates
qualification: for each method all four arms complete finite, mean across 2 seeds and 2 sites gain >=0.03, both seed averages positive and no site mean decrease >0.02; pass permits independent follow-up only
limitations: per-slice minmax is not case-volume minmax; unknown site-specific grouping, two seeds, separate GPUs not bitwise paired, two-task diagnostic not full evaluation
stop: any nonfinite loss, gradient, parameter or optimizer; loss>10000; any arm failure, deadline or storage cap; no automatic retry
